0022600181.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West, 1 game back in the division) are on the road against the Houston Rockets (6-1, 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West, 0.5 games back), who have won their last game and gone 6-1 over their last ten. Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 136-132 win in Houston on April 10, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain).
